      "snippet": "Good question — this is exactly the right place to pause and clarify before anything gets assumed.

What VRAM is (plain English)
VRAM = Video RAM
It is memory on your graphics card (GPU), not your main system memory.
Think of it like this:

RAM (your 64 GB):
Used by the CPU for general computing (apps, files, OS, Python scripts, etc.)

VRAM:
Used by the GPU to hold models, tensors, and activations when doing AI / ML work

For modern LLMs, VRAM matters more than CPU and often more than RAM.
